product_family: Alfred for macOS - a desktop productivity app with local workflow automation, app launcher, file search, clipboard history, and snippet expansion. Core app is free with optional Powerpack add-on; Alfred Remote for iOS also available.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1 or 2)
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence of SOC 2 certification on alfredapp.com or security pages. Product is a desktop application, not a cloud/SaaS platform, so SOC 2 not applicable.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence of ISO 27001 certification. Desktop app does not undergo ISO 27001 audits. Relies on Apple's Developer ID signing and notarization.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Alfred does not explicitly claim GDPR compliance. Payment processing via Paddle (GDPR compliant), but Alfred app itself makes no formal GDPR compliance claims. Desktop app with local data storage and minimal external data processing.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable. Alfred is a productivity app, not a health/medical product. No HIPAA scope or claims.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Alfred does not hold PCI DSS. Payment processing partner Paddle is PCI DSS SAQ A compliant, but Alfred itself does not process or store payment cards.

certifications.name: Apple Developer ID Signing & Notarization
certifications.proof_quote: Alfred 5 for Mac is Developer ID Signed and Notarised. Every update is automatically checked by Apple. This means the application undergoes Apple's security verification process with each update.

privacy.ai_training_note: Not an AI product. No training on customer data. Desktop app does not use ML/AI models.
privacy.data_region: Local (default); optional sync via Dropbox/similar user-controlled services

security.name: Code Signing
security.value: Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple for every update

security.name: Local-First Data Storage
security.value: Preferences and settings stored locally in user's Library folder by default. User data not sent to Alfred or third parties.

security.name: Search Tracking
security.value: No tracking of user searches. Explicitly do not track searches and do not send usage data home.

security.name: Internet Connectivity
security.value: Minimal and transparent. Only connects to internet for: license activation (Powerpack), periodic update checks, Alfred Gallery integration, and optional preference syncing.

security.name: Workflow Security
security.value: Workflows on Alfred Gallery are automatically and manually security checked, then notarized and signed using strong cryptography. Community auditing possible due to open-source nature.

security.name: Payment Processing
security.value: Handled by Paddle.com. Alfred does not store payment card data. Paddle is PCI DSS SAQ A and GDPR compliant.

security.name: Update Data Encryption
security.value: When app checks for updates, data is encrypted and never written to disk. No personal information is sent.

products.name: Alfred 5 for Mac (Free Core)
products.data_scope: Local only (hotkeys, keywords, text expansion, basic search)
products.notes: Free tier with core app-launching and file-search features. No data collection or external connectivity required for basic use.

products.name: Alfred Powerpack (Paid Add-on)
products.data_scope: Local + optional Dropbox sync for settings
products.notes: Paid feature add-on enabling workflows, advanced features, themes. License activation requires online connection. Optional settings sync via Dropbox.

products.name: Alfred Remote for iOS
products.notes: Optional paid companion app. Controls Mac via local network. No cloud sync reported.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free core + paid Powerpack add-on). One-time purchase, not subscription.
compare.data_residency: Local (on user's Mac). Optional sync via Dropbox at user discretion.
